basic_profile.bio: Avid anime enthusiast and budding tech geek from Seattle. Recently developed a keen interest in exploring the intricacies of manga storylines, particularly Hunter x Hunter. As a software developer by trade, I enjoy discussing the latest tech trends and wearables. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, between 7-10 PM PST. Currently single, I enjoy spending my weekends hiking in the Cascades or jamming with local musicians.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily self-taught in both anime lore and tech gadgets. My expertise in Hunter x Hunter stems from countless hours spent watching the anime, reading the manga, and engaging in online discussions. Professionally, I have a degree in Computer Science and have worked in the tech industry for several years, which fuels my interest in subreddits like AndroidWear.
